annotation.bound_parties_text: The section binds eligible entities (businesses) operating personal delivery devices and personal delivery device operators, and prohibits any person from operating such a device unless authorized.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No person shall operate a personal delivery device unless the person is authorized to do so under this section and complies with the requirements of this section.
annotation.dates_quote: September 29, 2017 – Enacted  by House Bill 49 - 132nd General Assembly
annotation.robot_provision_quote: September 29, 2017 – Enacted  by House Bill 49 - 132nd General Assembly
